About This Game
BEAST is a wildlife-themed strategy card game that authentically captures the law of the jungle — survival of the fittest. Players will collect over a hundred species of wild animals that have truly existed on Earth, lead their beast army, and compete against players from around the world.

BEAST is completely free to download and play. All cards can be obtained through gameplay progression, daily quests, and the achievement system.

How to Play BEAST?
BEAST builds upon traditional CCG card games and divides the board into Nests and Territories. The Nest is the animals' warm home, while the Territory is fraught with danger. However, if your animals occupy a Territory, they will directly threaten the opponent's Nest. Animal actions are no longer free — moving and attacking both consume stamina. Defend your Nest or fight for Territories? The choice is entirely yours!

Food is nature's gift. In BEAST, you can use food flexibly — summon ferocious beasts, or call upon the forces of nature and unleash terrifying natural disasters upon your opponent.

Game Strategy
Choose signature animals from one continent on Earth and combine them with marine animals to build your unique deck.

• Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Oceania — the signature animals from each continent bring distinct tactical strategies.
• Marine animals can be added to any deck, providing greater flexibility and strategic depth to your builds.

Battle continuously to climb the ranks. Each season offers generous rewards based on your rank.

A True Natural World
All in-game illustrations are based on real wild animals, featuring over 150 species — African Lion, Bengal Tiger, North American Gray Wolf, Burchell's Army Ant, Royal Albatross, and many more. The physical characteristics and behaviors of each animal are referenced from natural science literature.

Regular Updates and Events
BEAST will continue to introduce new game modes, new expansion packs, and limited-time events. We will also regularly host tournaments worldwide for players of all skill levels, with prize pools that include in-game items and cash prizes.

About the Team
Parrot Studios is an independent game studio based in Guangzhou, China, founded by a group of passionate card game players. We hope BEAST brings a unique gaming experience to players all around the world.
